$comment: Animation state map for the pixel-coder placeholder pet. Geometry matches openpets' defaultPetSprite exactly, so openpets' CSS sprite renderer works unchanged. Durations are openpets' defaults, which line up with these frame counts.

failed.note: frames 6-8 are identical; animation holds on the final slumped pose

waiting.note: DUPLICATE: byte-identical to row 0 (idle). Row is effectively free for a new action.

freeCells.$comment: Unused (fully transparent) cells available for new frames without resizing the sheet.

plannedNewStates.$comment: Needed by the behaviour spec but absent from this sheet. Row 6 is reclaimable; rows 9-11 require extending the sheet to 1536x2496.

sleep.note: can be approximated without new art: idle re-timed very slow + a CSS Z bubble

reactionMap.$comment: trigger -> animation state. Keep this indirection so new triggers are a mapping entry, not renderer work.
